beats.text: Traditional models are like runners in a relay race. Waiting for the baton to move forward.
beats.visual_focus: A single runner holding a baton, frozen in place while others wait behind him.

beats.text: This sequential dependency is the villain. It forces your expensive GPUs to sit idle. Waiting for the previous word to finish before calculating the next.
beats.visual_focus: A line of GPUs with progress bars that only fill one by one, leaving the rest dark.

visual_blueprint.title: COMPUTE STARVATION
visual_blueprint.sub: Hardware idling due to sequential logic

motif_params.title: COMPUTE STARVATION

beats.text: The Transformer architecture pivots to a parallel assembly line. It uses self-attention to look at every word in the sequence simultaneously.
beats.visual_focus: A matrix of connections lighting up all at once, replacing the single line of movement.
